message: can i ask some questions about CDI ?
i am writing my own OS and if i want to implement CDI interface, is there list of functions i need to implement in my OS ?
Well, for a complete implementation you need to implement everything that is in the header files
But most drivers only need a subset of it
You know the git tree at http://git.tyndur.org/?p=cdi.git;a=tree I suppose?
So to get started you should take the include/ directory from there and implement the functions of cdi.h
Next I would pick a simple driver and just add the functions that the linker complains about
Network drivers are pretty easy, but you need some TCP/IP stack to actually test them
If you don't have that, I'd suggest some storage driver, maybe floppy
